Data for mapping

fiji_basins12<-st_read(here("projected_data/Basins/Fiji_basins12.shp")) %>% 
  filter(!MAIN_BAS %in% c(5120082250)) %>% 
  mutate(ID = as.numeric(1)) %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(area_km2 = sum(area_km2, na.rm = T))
## Reading layer `Fiji_basins12' from data source `/home/kuempel/Fiji_sewage/projected_data/Basins/Fiji_basins12.shp' using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
## Simple feature collection with 125 features and 298 fields
## geometry type:  MULTIPOLYGON
## dimension:      XY
## bbox:           xmin: 1802869 ymin: 3756937 xmax: 2133466 ymax: 4499476
## projected CRS:  Fiji 1986 / Fiji Map Grid
## `summarise()` ungrouping output (override with `.groups` argument)
coral_export<-st_read(here("output_data/Nutrients/Fiji_corals_nutrient_export.shp")) 
## Reading layer `Fiji_corals_nutrient_export' from data source `/home/kuempel/Fiji_sewage/output_data/Nutrients/Fiji_corals_nutrient_export.shp' using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
## Simple feature collection with 12350 features and 12 fields
## geometry type:  POLYGON
## dimension:      XY
## bbox:           xmin: 1572263 ymin: 3467888 xmax: 2319879 ymax: 4624022
## CRS:            unknown
coral_export<- coral_export %>% 
  st_transform(., st_crs(fiji_basins12)) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_crop(., fiji_basins12) %>% 
  mutate(N_tonnes=Total_N *0.001,
         P_tonnes= Total_P *0.001)
## Warning: attribute variables are assumed to be spatially constant throughout all
## geometries
#coral_export_long<-coral_export %>% 
#  pivot_longer(., cols =c("Fj_c_N_" ,"Fj_c_P_" , "Fj_n_N_" , "Fj_n_P_" , "Fj___N_" , "Fj___P_" , "Total_N" , "Total_P" , "Ttl_ntr"), #names_to = "type", values_to = "value") %>% 
#  st_as_sf()

#conn_N<-raster(here("output_data/Nutrients/Fiji_connected_N_plumes.tif"))
fiji<-tm_shape(fiji_basins12) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_fill("linen")

fiji

test<-coral_export %>% 
  mutate(Ttl_ntr=ifelse(Ttl_ntr<=0, NA, as.numeric(Ttl_ntr)))

total_nutrients<-tm_shape(test) +
  tm_fill(col = "Ttl_ntr", 
          title = "Total nutrients (kg)", 
          style = "order",
          textNA = "Zero or NA") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = FALSE, bg.color = "lightblue",
            legend.position=c("left", "top"))

total_nutrients

test<-coral_export %>% 
  mutate(Total_N=ifelse(Total_N<=0, NA, as.numeric(Total_N)))

total_N<-tm_shape(test) +
  tm_fill(col = "Total_N", 
          title = "Nitrogen (kg)", 
          style = "order",
           textNA = "Zero or NA") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = FALSE, bg.color = "lightblue",
            legend.position=c("left", "top"))
test<-coral_export %>% 
  mutate(Total_P=ifelse(Total_P<=0, NA, as.numeric(Total_P)))

total_P<-tm_shape(test) +
  tm_fill(col = "Total_P", 
          title = "Phosphorus (kg)", 
          style = "order",
           textNA = "Zero or NA") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = FALSE, bg.color = "lightblue",
            legend.position=c("left", "top"))
nutri1<-fiji + total_N +tm_scale_bar(position=c("right", "bottom"))
nutri2<-fiji + total_P
nutri3<-fiji + total_nutrients
n_p_all<-tmap_arrange(nutri1, nutri2, nutri3, ncol = 3, nrow = 1)
n_p_all

tmap_save(n_p_all, here("figures/Fiji_N_P_all.png"), width=20, height=8, asp=0)
## Map saved to /home/kuempel/Fiji_sewage/figures/Fiji_N_P_all.png
## Resolution: 6000 by 2400 pixels
## Size: 20 by 8 inches (300 dpi)
